I’m Rajenthirakumar Abishek, an Information Systems undergraduate at Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka. I enjoy connecting the dots between raw data and the decisions that move things forward.

From exploring customer churn to understanding student performance, I use SQL, Python, Power BI and Tableau to ask better questions, find patterns and communicate what matters.
